3. "Before the days an extension adds are worked out, every closed rideshare, taxi or transit authorization on the claim must carry a reimbursement entry on the rental ledger."

- Closest alternatives excluded: (i) extending RA-26-0819-55206 as seq 4 — it is closed (`rental_authorization_closed` 2026-09-10 repairs_complete) and the rule extends "an open rental"; the rental extended is "the claim's most recently entered authorization", which after the acceptance is the SUV. (iii) Counting the 2024 claim's rows — excluded by "one claim number". (iv) Counting 24 agency days — agency_days_against_day_room caps at authorized + closing allowance (23). (v) Rideshare days 3 (receipt days) as covered days — covered days come from the first/last covered day rules (2); 3 is only the receipt's days_billed. (vi) Shop treated as Select — estimate rows say non_network_shop.
- "Do only the extension": the timing clauses state that the days an extension adds are not worked out until each state stands on the ledger; records show all three unmet, so an extension recorded now would leave its days unsettled under the visible rule. Excluded by visible sentences + records.
